summary: This bill amends Title 28 to require the President to nominate one Supreme Court justice every two years (in the first and third years after a presidential election), limits the active panel to the nine most junior justices by deeming any justice who has served 18 years retired from regular service, and authorizes senior justices to temporarily fill vacancies until a new appointment is confirmed.
